description.subtitle: Adidas sports backpack of Arsenal (47 x 30 cm) - black
description.tagline: La mochila perfecta para todo fan del Arsenal
description.intro: Arsenal's adidas backpack combines functionality, comfort and sporty style in a design designed to accompany you in any situation. Inspired by the identity of Arsenal FC, it incorporates the club's coat of arms and the adidas logo to show your passion for gunsers wherever you go.
key_benefits: Gran capacidad: Espacio amplio para llevar ropa, material deportivo y accesorios.
Padded design: Greater comfort during daily transport.
Durable fabric: Material prepared to withstand frequent use.
Zip closure: Security and quick access to your belongings.
Estilo oficial Arsenal: Escudo y detalles adidas inspirados en el club londinense.
